Enchanting Waterfront
The Tsim Sha Tsui Promenade, a picturesque waterfront stretch with panoramic views of the bustling harbourfront of Hong Kong, starts at the iconic Clock Tower next to the Star Ferry Pier, and winds its way along the coastline, offering sights of notable landmarks and breathtaking vistas.
Cultural Highlights
Pass by the Cultural Centre, which hosts a myriad of performances and exhibitions and the Hong Kong Museum of Art, with its extensive collection spanning centuries of artistic heritage. Continuing along the promenade you’ll see modern architectural innovation at K11 Musea, followed by the elegant and luxurious Rosewood Hotel.
Exciting Happenings
On special occasions, the promenade also becomes a front-row seat for breathtaking drone shows and pyrotechnics or fireworks displays. Venturing further, the promenade leads travellers through Tsim Sha Tsui East with many varied dining and shopping options before finishing in Hung Hom.
